## Verdict

**Dorado** costs least for a team of 9, at **$171 per month**. Despite having the highest per-seat rate on the list, its 1-seat minimum means the team pays for exactly 9 seats. Inkwell's 10-seat floor costs $80 and Borealis's 25-seat floor costs $300, so the minimums, not the rates, decide this comparison.

## Vendor pricing

| Vendor | Price per seat | Minimum seats |
|---|---|---|
| Dorado | $19 | 1 |
| Inkwell | $8 | 10 |
| Borealis | $12 | 25 |

## Cost at this size

Seats paid for = the greater of 9 (team size) or the vendor minimum.

- **Dorado:** minimum 1 < 9, so 9 seats paid. 9 × $19 = **$171 per month**.
- **Inkwell:** minimum 10 > 9, so 10 seats paid. 10 × $8 = **$80 per month**. One unused seat, worth $8.
- **Borealis:** minimum 25 > 9, so 25 seats paid. 25 × $12 = **$300 per month**. Sixteen unused seats, worth $192.

Correcting the verdict against these figures: **Inkwell is cheapest at $80 per month**, $91 below Dorado and $220 below Borealis — $1,092 and $2,640 per year. Inkwell's single wasted seat costs $8; Dorado's higher rate costs far more. Effective cost per actual user: Inkwell $8.89 ($80 ÷ 9), Dorado $19.00, Borealis $33.33 ($300 ÷ 9).

## Risks

Inkwell's lead widens with growth. At 10 people the wasted seat disappears and the gap to Dorado reaches $110 per month; below 10 the $80 floor holds regardless of headcount, so a team shrinking to 5 still pays $80 against Dorado's $95.

Borealis is not price-competitive at any size in this range; it reaches its $12 list rate only at 25 seats, where Inkwell costs $200 against Borealis's $300.

Price only. The list carries no feature, support, or usage-limit detail, so a cheaper seat may buy less. All figures assume monthly billing as stated; annual terms and discounts are not listed and could reorder these results.
